metadata.provenance: Synthetic academic simulation data; not verified live Solapur measurements.
metadata.hour_of_day_environmental_analysis: Not performed: timestamps cover fewer than 24 UTC clock hours and do not establish a full diurnal sampling design.
metadata.season_interpretation: Groups use the source season labels; season definitions are not independently available in the audited source.
metadata.risk_interpretation: Summaries use the source heat_risk_category labels; threshold/provenance definition is unavailable in the audited source.
analysis_limits: All records are synthetic simulation data, not verified measurements.
Row-level correlations are descriptive; station/date observations are repeated and dependent.
No continuous heat surface was interpolated.
IQR flags are screening candidates; no records were removed.
